# sq-31 — squalify v1 must not include Parquet or its DuckDB dependency

Removes Parquet from the v1 scope: the goals, the docs, the approved dependency list and the Parquet-only descriptor members and model types. A Parquet file is profiled as binary (generic byte profile, structured magic hint), like any other unsupported binary format.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Owner decision (2026-10-27), verbatim: "Drop Parquet from v1" (option text: "No Parquet support for now; revisit if a consumer needs it. Remove the parquet format from v1 goals."), after "duckdb inside seems like it adds a lot of bloat/heavy deps on an otherwise lightweight library". The owner also chose "Tag after sq-07 (Recommended)": v0.1.0 ships without Parquet, so the README and docs must not claim it.

sq-08 (Parquet profiler through DuckDB) is parked. The consumer (prism) does not read Parquet input.

Removing members now, before the schema freeze (sq-12), keeps dead placeholders out of the frozen v1 schema. Adding Parquet later is an additive change.
